declarations.signature: o5s_kernel.Rule → List Aeneas.Std.U8 → List Aeneas.Std.U8 → o5s_kernel.Mobility
declarations.definition:
fun rule p nm =>
  match rule with
  | o5s_kernel.Rule.Mutable => o5s_kernel.Mobility.Mutable
  | o5s_kernel.Rule.Immutable => o5s_kernel.Mobility.CreateOnce
  | o5s_kernel.Rule.HeadRelease =>
    if p ≠ [] ∧ nm.length ≤ p.length then o5s_kernel.Mobility.Forbidden
    else
      have f := if p = [] then 0 else p.length + 1;
      if o5s_kernel.Proofs.restHasL nm f o5s_kernel.Proofs.headsL then o5s_kernel.Mobility.Mutable
      else
        if o5s_kernel.Proofs.restHasL nm f o5s_kernel.Proofs.releasesL then
          o5s_kernel.Mobility.CreateOnce
        else o5s_kernel.Mobility.Forbidden
